race.title: Christmas Community Raceday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: GAELIC GLOW hails from an in-form yard and may well get off the mark on just his third handicap start. Interesting stable-switcher Madame La Papillon and course bumper winner Nobotheratall head the dangers, along with Circuit Breaker , while Mr Caulfield and Heritier are worth noting for support. GAELIC GLOW MADAME LA PAPILLON NOBOTHERATALL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Rossbridge (4/1), Circuit Breaker (7/1), Madame La Papillon (7/1), Nobotheratall (8/1), Gaelic Glow (10/1), Paddys Policy (10/1), Well Educated (12/1), Kadjar Des Mottes (12/1), Famous Liss (12/1), Bruce Banner (12/1), Mr Caulfield (14/1), Kingston Bridge (14/1), Heritier (16/1), Nitty Gritty (25/1)
